## Database-First Resolution
<!-- Verify DB is populated before downloads, verified flags, binary_to_source links -->

- [ ] CHK001 All database tables (packages, binaries, sources, binary_to_source) populated from spec BEFORE any download
- [ ] CHK002 Every record has `verified` field set; unverified records block download
- [ ] CHK003 Binary-to-source links established for every binary package
- [ ] CHK004 SQL queries can extract current state without executing downloads

## Package Cache Integrity
<!-- Examples: Package Verification, Metadata Integrity, Offline Availability -->

- [ ] CHK005 Every `.deb` in `cache/pool/` has matching SHA256 in `Packages.gz`
- [ ] CHK006 `Release.gpg` is present, valid, and signed by the admin's trusted key
- [ ] CHK007 Every binary package has a corresponding source package (versions may differ)
- [ ] CHK008 No dangling packages (missing dependencies) in the cache

## CLI Contract & Workflow
<!-- Examples: CLI commands, Dependency Resolution -->

- [ ] CHK009 `package_mgmt add <pkg>` populates DB, resolves deps, fetches missing packages + source
- [ ] CHK010 `package_mgmt remove <pkg>` removes from DB and cache without breaking other deps
- [ ] CHK011 `package_mgmt list` displays all cached packages with versions and metadata
- [ ] CHK012 `package_mgmt verify` validates checksums, GPG signatures, and binary-source parity
- [ ] CHK013 `package_mgmt sync` ingests apt-offline bundles, populates DB before ingesting files
- [ ] CHK014 `package_mgmt bootstrap` reinstalls the full cached stack on a fresh Debian LTS system

## Offline Workflow

- [ ] CHK015 Operator can configure apt sources to point at the cache without network
- [ ] CHK016 `apt install` succeeds from cache with network disabled
- [ ] CHK017 Full `bootstrap` completes on a fresh Debian LTS install from cache only
- [ ] CHK018 Cache handoff via USB is validated (operator verifies post-receipt)

## Debian Policy & Quality
<!-- Examples: Security & Signing, Reproducible Builds, DFSG Licensing -->

- [ ] CHK019 `lintian --I --e` returns zero ERROR and zero WARNING on all packages
- [ ] CHK020 `piuparts` install and remove tests pass in offline mode
- [ ] CHK021 All source packages build reproducibly: `dpkg-buildpackage -sa -nc -us` passes
- [ ] CHK022 Every package has a DFSG-compliant license declaration

## Error Handling & Logging

- [ ] CHK023 All user-facing errors use `_print_error()` with JSON format
- [ ] CHK024 Exit codes follow the defined scheme (0=success, 1=generic error, 100=app-specific)
- [ ] CHK025 Custom exceptions exist for each command domain (FetchError, VerifyError, SyncError, BootstrapError, DatabaseError)
- [ ] CHK026 Logging is selective (operation boundaries only) and does not replace print()
